newsitem.title: USA: AMR's SABRE sets IPO terms at $300 mln. [CORRECTED 23/9 15:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: AMR's SABRE sets IPO terms at $300 mln. [CORRECTED 23/9 15:05 GMT]

text.p: AMR Corp's SABRE Group Holdings Inc information technology subsidiary has set estimated terms of its initial public offering, valuing the IPO at about $300 million, according to a regulatory filing.
SABRE will offer 20.2 million shares in an estimated pricing range of 14 to 16 each, the filing said. The IPO is tentatively scheduled for early October, according to underwriter Goldman Sachs.
The SABRE unit consists mostly of AMR's proprietary reservation and information system. The division also provides information technology solutions to the airline industry.
The company has filed to trade under the symbol "TSG" on the New York Stock Exchange.
